name: Dead Man’s Breath (CR 10)
body:
Dead Man’s Breath
CR 10

XP 9,600
Type magic; Perception DC 34; Disable Device DC 34

EFFECTS

Trigger proximity (darkvision and see invisibility); Reset automatic

Effect negative energy mist (15-foot line; 10d6 negative energy damage; DC 20 Reflex for half damage)
